title: Optimized single-cell RNA sequencing protocol for mammalian preimplantation development
author: Boskovic, Yazgeldi, et al.
materials: Phusion Hot Start Flex 2× Master Mix

steps.title: Prepare capture buffer
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 g PEG 6000, 37 mL 3 M KCl and 500 µL 1 M Tris pH 8 to a 50 mL tube, dissolve under warm running water, and store at 21‑22 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare ERCC spike‑in dilution
steps.instruction: Make a 1:10 dilution of ERCC RNA Spike‑In mix, then a 1:100 dilution as a working stock; aliquot 1.3 µL of the 1:100 dilution into 0.2 mL tubes and store at –80 °C for up to 12 months. Immediately before library preparation, add 130 µL Buffer EB to a 1:100 stock tube to obtain a 10 000× dilution, then take 1 µL of this dilution for each library master mix.

steps.title: Prepare 20 µM adapter cassette
steps.instruction: Pre‑heat a heat block to 72 °C. In a 1.5 mL tube combine 20 µL Adapter‑1 ssDNA (100 µM stock), 20 µL Adapter‑2 ssDNA (100 µM stock), 2.5 µL KCl (2 M) to reach 50 mM final, and 57.5 µL nuclease‑free water (total 100 µL). Place the tube on the 72 °C block for 5 min, then turn off the block and let it cool slowly to 20‑22 °C. Aliquot 20 µL portions and store at –20 °C (stable ≤12 months); thaw on ice before each use.

steps.title: Prepare barcoded primer plate
steps.instruction: If primers arrive dry, dissolve each in nuclease‑free water to 100 µM stock and store at –20 °C. In a 48‑well plate add 10 µL of each 100 µM primer plus 90 µL nuclease‑free water to obtain 10 µM solutions in numerical order; store the plate at –20 °C. Prior to library preparation, move the plate to +4 °C and thaw for 3‑4 h.

steps.title: Prepare PCR2 primer mix
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube mix 10 µL primer PCR‑2cF (100 µM stock) and 10 µL primer PCR‑2cR (100 µM stock) to reach 10 µM final each, then add 80 µL nuclease‑free water (total 100 µL). Aliquot 20 µL portions and store at –20 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Pool samples and purify (day 1)
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well plate on a magnetic rack for 3 min to bind beads, then collect the clear supernatants into six 1.5 mL LoBind tubes. Purify each using a NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up column, centrifuging the silica membrane for 2 min (instead of 1 min) and pre‑heating the elution buffer to 70 °C for 5 min. Elute cDNA twice with 16 µL heated elution buffer, yielding 32 µL total. Remove 2 µL for TapeStation QC‑1; retain the remaining 30 µL for the next step. Pause point: store the library at –20 °C for up to 1 month.

substeps.instruction: Place plate on magnetic rack, wait 3 min.
Collect supernatants into six LoBind tubes.
Run PCR Clean‑up column with modified centrifugation (2 min) and pre‑heated elution buffer (70 °C, 5 min).
Elute twice with 16 µL each, total 32 µL cDNA.
Take 2 µL for QC‑1; keep 30 µL for downstream work.

steps.title: Final library purification (day 2)
steps.instruction: Transfer the PCR reaction from the 0.2 mL tube to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, place on a magnetic rack and wait until the supernatant is clear; transfer the clear supernatant to a new LoBind tube. Add 45 µL AMPure XP beads, vortex thoroughly, and incubate 10 min at 21‑22 °C. Place on the magnetic rack, discard the supernatant, spin the tube 10 s, return to the rack, and remove any residual supernatant. Resuspend the beads in 20 µL Buffer EB, mix, wait 3 min, then place on the rack again and collect the cleared solution (ready library) into a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube. Take 2 µL for QC‑3. Pause point: store the sequencing‑ready library at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Move PCR product to LoBind tube and bind on magnetic rack.
Transfer clear supernatant to a clean LoBind tube.
Add 45 µL AMPure XP beads, vortex, incubate 10 min (21‑22 °C).
Place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant.
Spin 10 s, keep on rack, remove residual supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 20 µL Buffer EB, mix, incubate 3 min.
Place on rack, collect cleared library into new LoBind tube.
Take 2 µL for QC‑3; optional storage at –20 °C (≤6 months).
